takeaway: Section of the left phrenic nerve alone paralyses the left hemidiaphragm; each dome has its own nerve, and the paralysed dome moves paradoxically.

lines.text: Which statement about paralysis of the left hemidiaphragm is true?
The phrenic nerve gives motor and sensory supply to the diaphragm, and leaves the cord high in the neck.
Each dome has its own nerve. Cut the left phrenic nerve alone,
and the left hemidiaphragm is paralysed. That is the true statement.
Instead of descending, the paralysed dome rises on inspiration: a paradoxical movement that helps detect it.
The healthy right dome still descends normally.
So the answer: it may be caused by section of the left phrenic nerve alone.
lines.say: (clears throat) So the answer: it may be caused by section of the left phrenic nerve alone.
